Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses SCOPE OF WORK The scope of work includes inspection, diagnosis, repair, servicing, replacement of defective components a nd procurement/supply of genuine spare parts required for the maintenance and repair of the specified ve hicle(s), as detailed in the bid/BOQ. INSPECTION AND ASSESSMENT The selected service provider shall inspect the vehicle and submit a detailed estimate indicating the natur e of defects, repair methodology, spare parts required, labour charges and applicable taxes, wherever appl icable. Repair work shall commence only after obtaining approval from the Buyer. GENUINENESS OF SPARE PARTS All spare parts supplied shall be genuine Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) parts or equivalent parts specifically permitted under the bid specifications. The service provider shall provide invoices, part numbe rs and supporting documents, wherever required, to establish the authenticity and compatibility of the part s supplied.

QUALITY OF REPAIR All repair work shall be carried out by qualified and experienced personnel in accordance with the vehicle manufacturer's recommended procedures and applicable safety standards. The vehicle shall be returned i n proper working condition after completion of the approved repairs. APPROVAL FOR ADDITIONAL WORK No additional repair, replacement of spare parts or expenditure beyond the approved scope and amount s hall be undertaken without prior written approval of the Buyer. Any unauthorised work or expenditure shall be at the sole responsibility of the service provider. DELIVERY PERIOD The repair work and supply of spare parts shall be completed within the delivery period specified in the bid /work order. Any anticipated delay shall be intimated to the Buyer in writing, along with reasons and the pr oposed completion date. WARRANTY The service provider shall provide a minimum warranty of 90 days on repair workmanship and a warranty of at least 180 days on supplied spare parts, or the OEM-prescribed warranty, whichever is lon ger, unless otherwise specified in the bid. Warranty shall cover defects attributable to faulty workmanship or defective supplied parts, subject to applicable warranty conditions. INSPECTION AND ACCEPTANCE The Buyer or an authorised representative shall have the right to inspect the repair work and supplied spar e parts before acceptance. Payment shall be processed only after satisfactory completion of the approved work, verification of the supplied items and submission of the required documents. REPLACEMENT OF DEFECTIVE PARTS Any spare part found defective, damaged, incompatible or not conforming to the bid specifications shall be replaced by the service provider at no additional cost to the Buyer within a reasonable period stipulated b y the Buyer. PRICE AND PAYMENT The quoted price shall include all applicable labour charges, spare parts, consumables, transportation, load ing/unloading, taxes and other incidental expenses, as applicable and specified in the bid. Payment shall b e made as per GeM provisions and applicable Government financial rules after satisfactory completion and acceptance of the work and submission of a valid invoice. VEHICLE CUSTODY AND SAFETY The service provider shall exercise due care while the vehicle is in its custody. The vehicle shall not be use d for any purpose other than inspection, testing and authorised repair. Any loss or damage attributable to the negligence of the service provider shall be dealt with in accordance with the applicable contractual pro visions. DOCUMENTATION The service provider shall submit the repair report, details of replaced parts, part numbers, warranty docu ments, tax invoice and completion certificate. COMPLIANCE WITH GEМ CONDITIONS All terms and conditions of the GeM bid, General Terms and Conditions (GTC), applicable service-specific c onditions and the accepted contract/work order shall remain applicable. In case of any inconsistency, the a pplicable GeM provisions and the contractually established order of precedence shall prevail. RIGHT OF THE BUYER The Buyer reserves the right to reject non-conforming spare parts or unsatisfactory repair work and to take action as per the bid conditions and applicable GeM provisions in case of breach of contractual obligations. FINAL ACCEPTANCE The repair work shall be treated as complete only after satisfactory inspection, functional testing, submissi on of the required documents and formal acceptance by the authorised representative of the Buyer.
